requirement_text: User shall be able to record exercises, repetitions, and the followed diet within the application.
user_story: As a fitness user, I want to record exercises, repetitions and my diet in the application, so that I can track my routine.
technical_task: Add logging of exercises, repetitions and the followed diet.
acceptance_criteria: Given the application, when the user records an exercise with repetitions, then the entry is saved.
Given the application, when the user records the diet followed, then the entry is saved.

requirement_text: The product shall be robust with fault tolerance.
rationale: "Robust with fault tolerance" names no specific faults or measurable behaviour.
clarification_questions: What does "robust" mean in testable terms?
Which faults must the product tolerate and how?

requirement_text: User shall be able to add interests.
user_story: As a user, I want to add interests, so that my profile reflects what I like.
technical_task: Allow users to add interests to their profile.
acceptance_criteria: Given the profile, when the user adds an interest, then it is saved.
Given saved interests, when the profile is viewed, then the interests are shown.

requirement_text: The LHCP chooses to view all patients with which he or she has ever had an office visit with.
user_story: As an LHCP, I want to view all patients I have ever had an office visit with, so that I can see my patient history.
technical_task: Show every patient with whom the LHCP has had an office visit.
acceptance_criteria: Given an LHCP with past office visits, when the LHCP opens the list, then all patients with whom the LHCP has had an office visit are shown.
Given a patient with whom the LHCP has had no office visit, when the LHCP opens the list, then that patient is not shown.

requirement_text: Agency user shall be able to understand file-level errors better.
rationale: "Better" is relative and no error information requirement is stated.
clarification_questions: What does "understand file-level errors better" mean in measurable terms?
Which file-level errors are meant and what information must be shown?

requirement_text: In each row the descriptive name is a link to the URL containing patient specific instructions.
requirement_text_raw: In each row  the descriptive name is a link to the URL containing patient specific instructions.
user_story: As a patient, I want each row's descriptive name to be a link to the patient specific instructions, so that I can open them.
technical_task: Make the descriptive name in each row a link to the URL that contains the patient specific instructions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a row in the list, when it is displayed, then its descriptive name is a link.
Given the link, when the user clicks it, then the URL containing the patient specific instructions opens.

requirement_text: If a movie is selected, there shall be a list of all theatres in that city where it is playing, along with show times.
user_story: As a moviegoer, I want to see all theatres in the city that show a selected movie, with show times, so that I can choose where to watch.
technical_task: After a movie is selected, list the theatres in that city where it is playing together with the show times.
acceptance_criteria: Given a selected movie, when the user opens it, then a list of all theatres in that city where it is playing is shown.
Given a theatre in the list, when it is displayed, then its show times are shown.

requirement_text: The user shall be able to add the Classroom number for the class.
user_story: As a teacher, I want to add the Classroom number for a class, so that students know where it takes place.
technical_task: Add a Classroom number field to the class record.
acceptance_criteria: Given a class, when the user enters a Classroom number, then it is saved with the class.
Given a saved class, when it is viewed, then the Classroom number is shown.

requirement_text: User shall update a blog by filling out a form with title, description, and content, with validation ensuring data integrity.
user_story: As a blogger, I want to update a blog through a form with title, description and content, with validation, so that my data stays correct.
technical_task: Provide a blog update form with title, description and content fields and validation of the entries.
acceptance_criteria: Given the blog update form, when the user fills in title, description and content and submits, then the blog is updated.
Given invalid entries in the form, when the user submits, then validation rejects them.

requirement_text: The product shall generate a CMA report in an acceptable time.
requirement_text_raw: The product shall generate a CMA report in an acceptable time.'
clarification_questions: How long is an "acceptable time" for generating a CMA report?

requirement_text: The system shall be user-friendly and intuitive for users of all technical abilities.
rationale: "User-friendly" and "intuitive" are subjective and not measurable.
clarification_questions: Which technical abilities must be covered?

requirement_text: The system shall be able to display its graphical user interface (GUI) within an 800 x 600 pixel resolution.
user_story: As a user, I want the graphical user interface to fit within an 800 x 600 pixel resolution, so that it is usable on small displays.
technical_task: Lay out the GUI so that it is fully displayed within 800 x 600 pixels.
acceptance_criteria: Given a display with 800 x 600 pixel resolution, when the application is started, then the entire GUI is displayed.
Given the GUI at 800 x 600 pixels, when the user uses all screens, then no part is cut off.

requirement_text: System shall maintain the quality of service without any compromise on performance.
rationale: "Without any compromise on performance" has no measurable target.
clarification_questions: Which quality of service measures and performance targets apply?
What counts as a "compromise" on performance?

requirement_text: The sensor must not miss more than 50 objects of object category TAF-Ordinary per hour in ODA-Standing, where the objects movement category is either Moving or Stationary and the object is missed for longer than 1 sensor cycle and less than 8 sensor cycles.
user_story: As a driver assistance engineer, I want the sensor to miss no more than 50 TAF-Ordinary objects per hour in ODA-Standing, so that detection is reliable.
technical_task: Limit misses of TAF-Ordinary objects in ODA-Standing, with movement category Moving or Stationary and missed for longer than 1 sensor cycle and less than 8 sensor cycles, to at most 50 per hour.
acceptance_criteria: Given objects of category TAF-Ordinary with movement category Moving or Stationary in ODA-Standing, when they are missed for longer than 1 sensor cycle and less than 8 sensor cycles, then no more than 50 such objects are missed per hour.
Given more than 50 such misses per hour, when they are counted, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: The software shall support touch interaction with the interface using fingers or a stylus for actions like drawing, manipulating objects, and adjusting tools.
user_story: As a user, I want to use touch with my fingers or a stylus for drawing, manipulating objects and adjusting tools, so that I can work naturally.
technical_task: Support touch interaction by finger or stylus for drawing, manipulating objects and adjusting tools.
acceptance_criteria: Given a touch screen, when the user draws with a finger or a stylus, then the drawing is made.
Given a touch screen, when the user manipulates objects or adjusts tools by touch, then the action is carried out.

requirement_text: The solution should isolate security functions from nonsecurity functions.
user_story: As a security architect, I want security functions isolated from nonsecurity functions, so that a fault in one does not affect the other.
technical_task: Separate security functions from nonsecurity functions in the design.
acceptance_criteria: Given the solution's design, when it is reviewed, then security functions are isolated from nonsecurity functions.
Given a failure in a nonsecurity function, when it occurs, then security functions are not affected.

requirement_text: The system shall have a user-friendly interface for various user roles.
user_story: As a user in any role, I want a user-friendly interface, so that I can work without confusion.
technical_task: Provide an interface suited to each user role.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user role, when the user opens the interface, then it shows the functions for that role.
Given different user roles, when each opens the interface, then each interface is suited to its role.
rationale: Role assumed: user in any role. "User-friendly" is not measured.

requirement_text: User shall be able to register by providing required details and receive a success message upon account creation.
user_story: As a new user, I want to register with the required details and get a success message, so that I know my account exists.
technical_task: Offer registration with the required details and show a success message when the account is created.
acceptance_criteria: Given the registration form, when the user provides the required details and submits, then the account is created.
Given the account is created, when registration completes, then a success message is shown.

requirement_text: System shall support emerging needs based on data analysis.
rationale: "Emerging needs" and the link to data analysis are not specified.
clarification_questions: Which emerging needs are meant and how are they derived from data analysis?
What must the system do to support them?

requirement_text: The LMS shall store all information about librarians and patrons, including their access keys and priority.
user_story: As a librarian, I want the LMS to store all information about librarians and patrons, including access keys and priority, so that accounts are complete.
technical_task: Store records for librarians and patrons including their access keys and priority.
acceptance_criteria: Given a librarian or patron, when the record is saved, then all information including access key and priority is stored.
Given a stored record, when it is opened, then it shows the access key and priority.

requirement_text: The FTSS shall configure each ICP to halt processing if any of the MPE tests fail.
requirement_text_raw: The FTSS shall [SRS288] configure each ICP to halt processing if any of the MPE tests fail.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the FTSS to configure each ICP to halt processing if any of the MPE tests fail, so that a failing ICP stops.
technical_task: Configure each ICP so processing halts when an MPE test fails.
acceptance_criteria: Given an MPE test fails on an ICP, when the ICP is configured by the FTSS, then it halts processing.
Given all MPE tests pass, when the ICP runs, then it continues processing.

requirement_text: The windows listing diagnostic results shall increase in height as needed to display entries up to a maximum of ten entries.
user_story: As a technician, I want the windows listing diagnostic results to grow in height up to ten entries, so that I can see the results.
technical_task: Make the diagnostic result windows increase in height as needed, up to a maximum of ten entries.
acceptance_criteria: Given diagnostic results, when more entries are added, then the window increases in height to display them up to ten entries.
Given more than ten entries, when they are listed, then the window height stays at the ten-entry maximum.
rationale: Role assumed: technician. How extra entries are shown is not stated.

requirement_text: Clicking 'OK' will mark this item as cleared indicating that billing has been completed for this encounter.
requirement_text_raw: Clicking 'OK' will mark this item as cleared  indicating that billing has been completed for this encounter.
user_story: As a billing clerk, I want clicking OK to mark an item as cleared, so that I know billing is completed for the encounter.
technical_task: Mark the item as cleared when OK is clicked, indicating billing is completed for the encounter.
acceptance_criteria: Given an item awaiting clearance, when the clerk clicks OK, then it is marked as cleared.
Given a cleared item, when it is viewed, then it indicates that billing has been completed for the encounter.

requirement_text: The database shall be maintained using MySQL, and the server will be Apache; in case of system failure, both the database and server can be reinitialized.
user_story: As a system administrator, I want the database in MySQL and the server on Apache, with both re-initializable after a failure, so that I can recover them.
technical_task: Maintain the database with MySQL, run the server on Apache and allow both to be reinitialized after a system failure.
acceptance_criteria: Given the system, when its components are listed, then the database is in MySQL and the server is Apache.
Given a system failure, when it occurs, then both the database and the server can be reinitialized.

requirement_text: System dependability ensures users are informed of any issues for trusted system performance , measured during testing and prioritized highly.
rationale: The sentence mixes outcomes and process statements, with no clear testable behaviour.
clarification_questions: What does "system dependability" require the system to do?
How is "prioritized highly" and "trusted performance" measured?

requirement_text: Science analysis software shall be integrated into the NASA approved data repository.
user_story: As a scientist, I want science analysis software integrated into the NASA approved data repository, so that I can analyze data where it is held.
technical_task: Integrate the science analysis software into the NASA approved data repository.
acceptance_criteria: Given the NASA approved data repository, when the science analysis software is installed, then it is integrated into it.
Given integrated science analysis software, when a scientist uses it, then it works with the repository.

requirement_text: The CNG shall support the connection to a STB (or media gateway) both in a bridged or in a routed mode of operation.
user_story: As a home network user, I want the CNG to connect to a STB or media gateway in bridged or routed mode, so that my set-top box works either way.
technical_task: Support the connection of a STB (or media gateway) to the CNG in bridged and in routed mode.
acceptance_criteria: Given a STB or media gateway, when the CNG is in bridged mode, then the connection is supported.
Given a STB or media gateway, when the CNG is in routed mode, then the connection is supported.

requirement_text: System shall ensure that enabling or disabling explore for a dataset does not result in silent loss of data or data available for explore.
user_story: As a data owner, I want enabling or disabling explore for a dataset never to lose data silently, so that data stays available.
technical_task: Ensure enabling or disabling explore on a dataset does not silently lose data or the data available for explore.
acceptance_criteria: Given a dataset, when explore is enabled, then no data is lost silently.
Given a dataset, when explore is disabled, then no data is lost silently and no data available for explore is lost without notice.

requirement_text: A subset of FTSS shall reside on the ICP.
requirement_text_raw: A subset of FTSS shall (3.3.11.7) reside on the ICP.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want a subset of FTSS to reside on the ICP, so that the ICP has local services.
technical_task: Place a subset of the FTSS software on the ICP.
acceptance_criteria: Given the ICP, when its software is inspected, then a subset of FTSS resides on it.
Given the FTSS software, when it is deployed, then not all of it is required on the ICP.

requirement_text: After initial synchronization, the FCPs shall remain synchronized until a hardware fault occurs. For example, asymmetric I/O calls will not be allowed to induce a large enough skew to force the FCPs to desynchronize.
requirement_text_raw: After initial synchronization, the FCPs shall [SRS168] remain synchronized until a hardware fault occurs.  For example, asymmetric I/O calls will not be allowed to induce a large enough skew to force the FCPs to desynchronize.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the FCPs to stay synchronized after initial synchronization until a hardware fault occurs, so that they act together.
technical_task: Keep the FCPs synchronized after initial synchronization until a hardware fault, and prevent asymmetric I/O calls from inducing a skew large enough to desynchronize them.
acceptance_criteria: Given initial synchronization has completed, when no hardware fault occurs, then the FCPs remain synchronized.
Given asymmetric I/O calls, when they occur, then they are not allowed to induce a skew large enough to force the FCPs to desynchronize.

requirement_text: Users shall be able to register with PRACTO using valid information and log in using their credentials to access PRACTO services.
user_story: As a patient, I want to register with PRACTO using valid information and log in with my credentials, so that I can use PRACTO services.
technical_task: Provide registration and login for PRACTO using valid information and credentials.
acceptance_criteria: Given valid information, when the user registers with PRACTO, then an account is created.
Given valid credentials, when the user logs in, then the user can access PRACTO services.

requirement_text: User shall/will be provided with reports generated in a time not exceeding five seconds.
user_story: As a manager, I want reports generated in no more than five seconds, so that I don't wait.
technical_task: Generate every report within five seconds.
acceptance_criteria: Given a report request, when the report is generated, then it takes no more than five seconds.
Given a report that takes longer than five seconds, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: The system shall allow consumers to download data packages in specific versions.
user_story: As a data consumer, I want to download data packages in specific versions, so that I get exactly the version I need.
technical_task: Provide download of data packages by chosen version.
acceptance_criteria: Given a data package with several versions, when the consumer selects a version, then that version is downloaded.
Given a downloaded data package, when it is checked, then it is the selected version.

requirement_text: If a failure in an FCR other than the NEFU is diagnosed when the FCP is configured as a degraded triplex, no action shall be taken. Note that a failed FCR could be diagnosed using any method, including (but not limited to) Continuous BIT, ICP presence test, or NE syndrome analysis.
requirement_text_raw: If a failure in an FCR other than the NEFU is diagnosed when the FCP is configured as a degraded triplex, no action shall [SRS254] be taken.  Note that a failed FCR could be diagnosed using any method, including (but not limited to) Continuous BIT, ICP presence test, or NE syndrome analysis.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want no action taken when an FCR other than the NEFU fails while the FCP is a degraded triplex, so that the system stays stable.
technical_task: Take no action when a failure is diagnosed in an FCR other than the NEFU while the FCP is configured as a degraded triplex, regardless of the diagnosis method.
acceptance_criteria: Given the FCP is configured as a degraded triplex, when a failure in an FCR other than the NEFU is diagnosed, then no action is taken.
Given a failed FCR diagnosed by Continuous BIT, ICP presence test or NE syndrome analysis, when the FCP is a degraded triplex, then no action is taken either.

requirement_text: You may click 'Edit' next to any of these forms to edit its contents.
user_story: As a clinician, I want to click Edit next to a form to edit its contents, so that I can correct it.
technical_task: Add an Edit control next to each form that opens its contents for editing.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of forms, when the user clicks Edit next to one, then its contents can be edited.
Given an edited form, when the user saves it, then the changes are saved.

requirement_text: The real time clock must be able to cover longer periods of time and schedule events without inbetween wake ups.
user_story: As a hardware engineer, I want the real time clock to cover longer periods and schedule events without wake ups in between, so that power is saved.
technical_task: Extend the real time clock's coverage of time and let it schedule events without intermediate wake ups.
acceptance_criteria: Given a long period to cover, when the real time clock is used, then it covers the period.
Given scheduled events, when the real time clock schedules them, then no wake up happens in between.
rationale: Role assumed: hardware engineer. "Longer" is relative to a baseline not given.

requirement_text: System shall maintain and display marks obtained by students in different semesters, including internal and external marks, total marks, and credits.
user_story: As a student, I want to see my marks in different semesters, with internal and external marks, total marks and credits, so that I know my results.
technical_task: Store and display marks per semester including internal marks, external marks, total marks and credits.
acceptance_criteria: Given marks for several semesters, when the student opens the marks page, then the marks are shown per semester.
Given a semester, when it is displayed, then internal marks, external marks, total marks and credits are shown.

requirement_text: This produces a report including all the specified patient information.
user_story: As a billing clerk, I want a report with all the specified patient information, so that I can review it.
technical_task: Generate a report that contains all specified patient information.
acceptance_criteria: Given specified patient information, when the report is produced, then it contains all of it.
Given the report, when it is opened, then it shows the patient information.
rationale: Role assumed: billing clerk. The specified information is not listed.

requirement_text: Website must be fully operational with MSN TV2.
requirement_text_raw: Website must be fully operational with MSN TV2.'
user_story: As a viewer, I want the website to be fully operational with MSN TV2, so that I can use it on my television.
technical_task: Verify that the website works fully on MSN TV2.
acceptance_criteria: Given MSN TV2, when the user opens the website, then it is displayed.
Given MSN TV2, when the user uses the website's functions, then they all work.

requirement_text: The accuracy of obj_y for objects having object extension category PointTarget shall be at least 0.05 m for objects closer than 10m (Euclidean distance from the center point of the sensor 's front face), where the accuracy is compared to a point on the object 's contour.
user_story: As a driver assistance engineer, I want the accuracy of obj_y for PointTarget objects to be at least 0.05 m for objects closer than 10m, so that close objects are located precisely.
technical_task: Achieve an accuracy of at least 0.05 m for obj_y of objects with object extension category PointTarget closer than 10m, compared to a point on the object's contour.
acceptance_criteria: Given a PointTarget object closer than 10m, when obj_y is compared with a point on the object's contour, then the accuracy is at least 0.05 m.
Given an accuracy worse than 0.05 m, when it is measured for such an object, then the requirement is not met.
rationale: Role assumed: driver assistance engineer. The distance is the Euclidean distance from the sensor's front face center point.

requirement_text: Performance must meet specified requirements even under high user load.
user_story: As a user, I want performance requirements met even under high user load, so that the system stays usable.
technical_task: Meet the specified performance requirements while the user load is high.
acceptance_criteria: Given a high user load, when users use the system, then the specified performance requirements are met.
Given a normal user load, when users use the system, then the specified performance requirements are met.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The performance requirements and the load are defined elsewhere.

requirement_text: System shall showcase the latest safety tips and tools for LPG usage.
user_story: As an LPG customer, I want to see the latest safety tips and tools for LPG usage, so that I use it safely.
technical_task: Display current safety tips and tools for LPG usage.
acceptance_criteria: Given safety tips and tools for LPG usage, when the user opens the safety section, then the latest ones are shown.
Given a new safety tip, when it is added, then it appears among the latest tips.

requirement_text: The user shall have the option to sign up using their Google account.
user_story: As a new user, I want the option to sign up with my Google account, so that I don't need a new password.
technical_task: Offer sign-up through a Google account.
acceptance_criteria: Given the sign-up page, when the user chooses to sign up with a Google account, then the account is created using it.
Given the sign-up page, when it is displayed, then signing up with a Google account is offered.

requirement_text: The product shall prevent its data from incorrect data being introduced.
requirement_text_raw: The product shall prevent its data from incorrect data being introduced.'
user_story: As a site owner, I want the product to prevent incorrect data from being introduced, so that its data stays reliable.
technical_task: Validate input so that incorrect data is not stored.
acceptance_criteria: Given incorrect data is entered, when it is submitted, then it is not stored.
Given correct data is entered, when it is submitted, then it is stored.
rationale: Role assumed: site owner. What counts as incorrect is not defined.

requirement_text: The ARC shall use an infrared filter wich is open for a short waveband to improve night performance, using the vehicles infrared headlights.
user_story: As a driver assistance engineer, I want the ARC to use an infrared filter that is open for a short waveband and the vehicle's infrared headlights, so that night performance improves.
technical_task: Equip the ARC with an infrared filter open for a short waveband and use the vehicle's infrared headlights to improve night performance.
acceptance_criteria: Given the ARC, when its optics are inspected, then it uses an infrared filter that is open for a short waveband.
Given night driving, when the ARC operates, then it uses the vehicle's infrared headlights.
rationale: Role assumed: driver assistance engineer. "Short waveband" is not quantified.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to import Data Packages into various platforms like Node.js, Julia, R, Excel, SPSS, STATA, LibreOffice/OpenOffice, Python, Clojure, C++.
user_story: As a data scientist, I want to import Data Packages into Node.js, Julia, R, Excel, SPSS, STATA, LibreOffice/OpenOffice, Python, Clojure and C++, so that I can use them in my tools.
technical_task: Provide import of Data Packages into platforms including Node.js, Julia, R, Excel, SPSS, STATA, LibreOffice/OpenOffice, Python, Clojure and C++.
acceptance_criteria: Given a Data Package, when the user imports it into a listed platform such as Python or R, then the data is available there.
Given a Data Package, when the user imports it into Excel, SPSS, STATA or LibreOffice/OpenOffice, then the data is available there.
rationale: Role assumed: data scientist. "Like" means the list may not be complete.

requirement_text: The streaming server will support 50 simultaneous streaming connections.
requirement_text_raw: The streaming server will support 50 simultaneous streaming connections.'
user_story: As a viewer, I want the streaming server to support 50 simultaneous connections, so that many people can watch at once.
technical_task: Size the streaming server for 50 simultaneous streaming connections.
acceptance_criteria: Given 50 simultaneous streaming connections, when they are open, then the server supports all of them.
Given fewer than 50 connections, when they are open, then the server supports them.

requirement_text: System shall stop protecting the device from threats if the software validity exceeds the limit.
user_story: As a user, I want protection to stop when the software validity exceeds its limit, so that I know the software has expired.
technical_task: Stop protecting the device from threats once the software validity exceeds the limit.
acceptance_criteria: Given the software validity exceeds the limit, when the check runs, then the system stops protecting the device from threats.
Given the software validity is within the limit, when the check runs, then protection continues.
rationale: Role assumed: user. What happens to the user notice is not stated.

requirement_text: System shall be robust, scalable, flexible, and user-friendly to meet diverse user needs effectively.
clarification_questions: Which diverse user needs must be met?

requirement_text: RAM scrub shall actively trigger the EDAC function by cyclically reading (and writing back if an error is found) all used RAM.
requirement_text_raw: RAM scrub shall [SRS043] actively trigger the EDAC function by cyclically reading (and writing back if an error is found) all used RAM.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want RAM scrub to trigger the EDAC function by cyclically reading all used RAM and writing back when an error is found, so that memory errors are corrected.
technical_task: Run RAM scrub as a cyclic read of all used RAM that writes data back if an error is found, thereby triggering the EDAC function.
acceptance_criteria: Given RAM scrub is running, when it cycles, then it reads all used RAM.
Given an error is found while reading, when RAM scrub detects it, then the data is written back.
